outcome: Maternal adverse events (gestational hypertension, COVID-19 re-infection, fatigue, gestational diabetes, headache, morning sickness)
Maternal serious adverse events (prolonged labor, pre-eclampsia, polyhydramnios, premature labor, urinary retention)
Infant/fetal adverse events (COVID-19, ear infection, neonatal dyspnea, respiratory syncytial virus infection)
Infant/fetal serious adverse events (fetal cardiac disorder, congenital ankyloglossia, persistent right umbilical vein, congenital hydronephrosis, major congenital malformation)
cohort: The study included 39 pregnant participants who received sotrovimab for mild, moderate, or severe COVID-19 during pregnancy, enrolled in the COVID-19 International Drug Pregnancy Registry.
finding: None of the assessable serious adverse events reported in either mothers or infants were considered to be related to sotrovimab treatment.
birth_weight: Ranged from 2381 g to 4762 g, with a mean of 3439.91 g
